subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Touch Target Size Testing
description: A quick, practical guide to Touch Target Size Testing.

hook.text: A mobile button is 20 by 20 pixels. Users with motor impairments tap the wrong button repeatedly.

buildup.text: WCAG 2.2 requires a minimum touch target size of 24 by 24 CSS pixels, with 44 by 44 recommended.

discovery.text: Testing target sizes covers buttons, links, checkboxes, and any tappable element on touch screens.

twist.text: Spacing between targets matters too. Two tiny buttons side by side cause more errors than size alone.

climax.text: Increasing targets to 44px minimum and adding 8px spacing between them cuts mis-taps by 65%.

punchline.text: Big enough to tap. Spaced enough to miss the wrong one.

quiz.question: What is the WCAG 2.2 minimum touch target size?
